status: ENGINE CORE built 2026-10-08 (tools/dungeon.py, pack cobblers_dungeons): the timer, the greed ladder's counter, the slots and their shells, the staged boss's chain, the recall sweep, E1's engine half, entry and exit, the sigils and the rip. Generated and unit-tested; NOTHING of it has run on a server (experiments/EXP-084-dungeon-engine-core, NOT_EXECUTED). NOT built (step 6): the stands and their clawback, the seam markers and rate source, the parkour catch bands, the lake and the den. The spine is a PLACEHOLDER (spine.placeholder), so the engine can run end to end before world-content-dev authors the real one (step 4).
rung: datapack plus functions/commands (CLAUDE.md principle 6): vanilla scoreboards, bossbars, interactions, advancements and recipes, and Cobblemon 1.8.0's own commands (spawnnpcat, runmolang) and battle_victory callback. Every lower rung is exhausted by the record DUNGEONS.md 11.1 cites (DM 4.1: no 1.8.0 callback can cancel anything, so no-deploy is a sweep; DM 1.1: no native run timer). Nothing here is a mod, a script layer or a companion.
tunable: EVERY clock, delay and threshold below is tunable data, not a decided number: probe XT1 (EXP-079) timed no fight, so the band clocks are DUNGEONS.md 4.2's planning values (relayed), and the delays are the engine's own choices

engine.pack_why: world-local (tools/reapply.py WORLD_LOCAL): the keeper kills players on a timer, spawns NPCs, takes and gives items and sets game modes on its own; the global datapacks folder is loaded by every world the server runs, the live one included

pocket.read_from: data/portals.json pocket.dimension and pocket.floor_y, and data/entei_boss.json pocket.border and border_margin: tools/dungeon.py fails closed if any disagrees (as tools/entei_boss.py does). The dimension is cobblers_portals' and registers only at a boot

slots.why: DUNGEONS.md section 1: 4 slots per dungeon, one strip each, 2,048 long in x and at most 64 wide in z, 128-block rows from z 1,024. Slot k of dungeon d is row (d-1)*4 + (k-1): its strip is z0 = rows_from_z + row * row_spacing .. z0 + strip_width_max - 1, x origin_x .. origin_x + strip_length - 1, its spine along +x at the strip's centre line z0 + strip_width_max / 2. tools/dungeon.py refuses any overlap with the portals' rescue box (z -512..768 on every x), Entei's band (z around -768) and the probe pack's row (z -704..-577, data/dungeon_probes.json), each recomputed from its own file
slots.overworld_coincidence: the rows are inside the overworld map's x/z bounds (data/world.json 0..8191), unlike Entei's (data/entei_boss.json pocket.origin_why). What that risks is the blackout's waystone arrival test, which compares coordinates and not dimensions (data/blackout.json checkpoints.waystone_jump_why): tools/dungeon.py refuses any slot's arrival point within waystone_arrival_radius + 1 of a town waystone in data/progression.json, and the keeper's own box tests are made dimension-safe by the dg.pk tag (a box test on @s is coordinate-only)
slots.clear_strip_why: false for the placeholder: the pocket is void, so the shell writes only its own boxes. A shell from an earlier, LONGER spine is not cleared by a later shorter one; set true for the first apply of the real spine (step 4) to air the whole strip first (I2, EXP-081: one 2,048 x 64 strip cleared in one function call stalls the server 2.64 s fresh). A re-apply step only, never at entry

engine.members_why: solo first (D16). The data and the scores carry a member index (bossbar ..._m1) so co-op is a switch, not a rewrite; the gates, the bar and the slot's freeing are written per member

keeper.arrive_delay_why: Entei's (data/entei_boss.json keeper.arrive_delay_ticks), counted by the keeper on the player, so a player who logs out before arriving arrives when they return: at least 40 ticks after door_click, at most 40 + one period
keeper.entry_hold_why: an engine choice, not in DUNGEONS.md: a member who has paid but not crossed the threshold holds no clock, so 2.6's slot deadline would never come. This many ticks of absence before the threshold frees the slot; on their return the run is void and the sigil returned (the threshold refund, 7.4). Five minutes
keeper.rip_particle_why: DUNGEONS.md 7.1: re-emitted every 10 ticks while a player is within 48 blocks, so an unvisited rip costs one distance check. V1 (EXP-080) found these particles cannot be seen from 64-128 blocks; the plume is gated on the owner's look (rips[].plume)
keeper.boss_restart_why: an engine choice: a forfeit or flee sends no battle result (DM 1.4), which would leave a stage standing with the exit gate shut. After this many passes out of battle with the stage standing and no result, the keeper starts the same stage's battle again

clock.ladder_basis: D13 (the owner, 2026-10-08): x1.25 at 5, x1.5 at 10, x2.0 at 15, x3 at 20, per member, holding for the rest of the run. Quarter-ticks, so x1.25 is an integer rate (DUNGEONS.md 2.1)
clock.why: DUNGEONS.md 2.1-2.2: dg.clock on the player in quarter-ticks, the keeper subtracting period_ticks x rate each pass; no rate 0 (D1); titles at 5:00 and 1:00 and each of the last 10 seconds

return_margin.why: DUNGEONS.md 2.3: back_s = (x - x_back) x 10 / 56 (sprint 5.6 blocks a second, relayed GYM_INTERIORS.md:139), plus the parkour's re-crossing once past it (0: the placeholder spine has no parkour); the warning fires when real seconds left at the current rate fall under back_s + 60

engine.lockout_why: D17: one hour of UPTIME per dungeon per player, counted from the threshold (2.5). Our own counter (#up dg.up, 20 a keeper pass), never gametime, so a re-export or /time set cannot move it. It must be at least the longest clock (39 minutes = 46,800 ticks)
engine.bands_why: DUNGEONS.md 5.3 (caps) and 4.2's planning table (relayed: 29, 31, 32, 34, 37, 39 minutes). A player's band is the first whose highest cap is at or above their RCT level cap at the rip (5.1), frozen for the run. The clocks are for the REAL spine's walk and fights; with the placeholder spine V3 (clock = ceil(required x slack) over the built shell) cannot hold and is not claimed

death.rule:
E1 (DUNGEONS.md 11.3), the engine half: door_click adds the run tag in the function that reserves the slot, BEFORE the arrival delay, and cancels any tail still counting; the engine never removes the tag; after every way out (a clean exit, the eject, the respawn after a death, the dead-run kill, a run voided before the threshold) it starts a tail of tail_ticks + period_ticks on its own score dg.tail and, when it ends with the player OUTSIDE cobblers:pocket, runs `execute as

at @s run function `; its overworld sweep runs for a tagged player outside the pocket with no live run and no tail. Neither is ever called in the pocket. Every NPC the engine spawns carries claims.exempt_tag in the function that spawns it, and the keeper re-asserts it on any untagged NPC in a slot a pass later
death.tail_why: tail_ticks + period_ticks: the tail is counted down period_ticks per keeper pass, and a tail started between passes (a click) would otherwise end up to period_ticks - 1 short of tail_ticks
death.pre_threshold_death_why: an engine choice: a death before the threshold (nothing in the entry room can kill, so /kill or a wild hit at the rip's mouth while arriving) does not return the sigil; only a walk out by the back rip does (7.4)
death.titles_why: DUNGEONS.md 2.5, by cause (dg.cause): 1 the timer, 2 a boss stage (or any NPC) beat them, 3 anything else, 4 a run that died while they were away (2.6)
chat: Your items are all still yours. Nothing in a rift keeps them.
The blackout's money is gone for good. No one in the rift is holding it.
Kept: everything you mined and picked up.
death.chat_why: DUNGEONS.md 2.5's lines 1, 2 and 4, as drafted there (trainer-balance-designer to tone). Line 2 is printed without the amount (the blackout's own line names it); line 3 (the escrow) and line 5 (the lockout) are built by the keeper from scores
death.away_line: The rift closed while you were away.
death.away_line_why: 2.6's line, without its minutes: the slot's deadline is freed with the slot, so the minutes are not kept

escrow.status: the extension point only: no reward table is built tonight (section 9 is step 6's). A clean exit runs dungeons/pay, which is empty but for clearing dg.esc; every other way out clears it. dg.bossd is set when the boss's last stage falls, the flag 9.1's boss escrow will key on

Nothing sets it tonight, so a boss stage's NPC payout is NOT clawed back by this build (does_not_cover)

adventure.rule: the arrival sets adventure and the tag; every way out, and the overworld backstop for a tagged player with no live run outside the pocket, sets survival and removes it. Only a player WE put in adventure is ever set to survival (V13)

rift_pick.name: Rift Pick
rift_pick.can_break_basis: R2 (EXP-074): `minecraft:can_break={predicates:[{blocks:[...]}]}` parses. The seam's per-band ore lists are step 6's; these are the band-1 seam's coal and iron (9.3) so the pick has something to name
rift_pick.taken_by: its custom_data (a byte, cobblers_dg_pick:1b), never its item id (DUNGEON_DEATH.md section 4 rule 6)

sweep.rule: DUNGEONS.md 3.4: every keeper pass, in each no-deploy box of a slot whose run is live, every cobblemon:pokemon without dg.keep is removed by `execute as <it> run runmolang "q.entity.discard;"` (P1's form 2, EXP-069 step 5: PASS on a wild Pokemon), every player in the box is dismounted, and ender pearls are killed. Never `kill`
sweep.gated_on: P1 (owner half): discarding an OWNED sent-out Pokemon, and that it returns to the party with its HP kept (DM 4.2), is unproven
sweep.message: The rift will not hold them here.

sigils.accept_rule: one of the entrant's own band if held, else the lowest higher band held; only a lower band's: refused, 'This sigil is too weak for you now.' (7.4)
sigils.custom_data_type_why: FINDING (2026-10-08): SG1 (EXP-083) step 5 proved `[custom_data~{cobblers_dg_sigil:1}]` against a sherd STOCKED with an int 1, but step 7 read the CRAFTED sigil as `cobblers_dg_sigil: 1b` (a recipe's JSON number becomes the smallest NBT type). An NBT partial match compares tag types (1b is not 1), so the int predicate would very likely never match a crafted sigil. The engine matches, gives and refunds the byte form throughout; the match against a CRAFTED sigil is unproven (EXP-084 step SG)

free_first_entry.staging_value: STAGING VALUE, NOT A DECISION: no free entry, a sigil always required. The owner did not accept 7.4's recommendation (the Night Shift's first run free, once per player) and owes an alternative. List a dungeon id here to give its first run free; the engine then marks the free entry with the impossible advancement cobblers:dungeons/free/<id> at door_click and needs no sigil for it

modes.all: every player knows all six (7.4's recommendation: the rip checks the band, so an early higher sigil only overpays)

That only overpays (the rip checks the band)

does_not_cover: Pokemon a player sends out OUTSIDE a no-deploy box: the sweep runs only in those boxes (3.4), and nothing else in a slot removes a send-out
items dropped in a slot: nothing collects them; a reset does not clear them

an NPC or Pokemon that is not ours standing in a slot: the keeper binds any untagged cobblemon:npc in a slot's box as ours (the exempt tag), but a wild Pokemon there is untouched; the pocket's void biome spawns nothing (data/portals.json generator.biome_why, NOT VERIFIED for Cobblemon)
a boss stage's NPC payout: the clawback is step 6, so a won stage pays CobbleDollars' NPC payout today (contract 'dungeon wins pay $0 net' is not met by this build)
the stands, the seam, the parkour's catch bands, the lake and the den (step 6); the seam's call into the greed ladder is cobblers:dungeons/greed/take

a player in co-op: members_max is 1, and the second account (XD8) is needed for its proofs
